conditions: Put the credit on the Credits screen using the FAQ format: "Dark Times Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)", followed by "Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0", with a link or URL to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. If the file is edited (trimmed or crossfaded to make the loop), the credit must say so: CC BY 4.0 Section 3(a)(1)(B) requires it, and the FAQ says "MUST make it clear in the credits which parts are yours". Do not add DRM or other technical measures that stop people using the file under the license (Section 2(a)(5)(C)). A plain public R2 object is fine. Do not suggest Kevin MacLeod endorses Mood Read.
